hip_clean.scenario: Clean build: main.hip holds a saxpy __global__ kernel, and main allocates two device arrays with hipMalloc, launches the kernel, synchronizes, and frees both, checking every hipError_t; the remote test builds the same program

hip_device_undefined.scenario: Device-side link: the kernel apply calls device_helper, declared __device__ and never defined, so the gfx942 device code refers to a function no translation unit defines

hip_host_calls_device.scenario: Host-side target error: main, a host function, calls device_scale, which is declared __device__ only

hip_kernel_calls_host.scenario: Device-side target error: the kernel scale calls host_scale, a plain host function with no __device__ attribute

hip_linker_error.scenario: Host linker error: main calls helper, which is declared and never defined, so the host link of the program fails

hip_missing_header.scenario: Missing header: main.hip includes p176_no_such_header.h, which neither the build directory nor any include directory holds, a fatal error at the include line

hip_undeclared_identifier.scenario: Undeclared identifier: the body of the kernel scale uses undefined_var, which is never declared

hip_unused_variable.scenario: Warning that stays a warning: the kernel scale declares unused and never reads it, so -Wall warns (-Wunused-variable) and the build succeeds, exit status 0
